subject: Problem with writeWave after using ffilter: file contains no sound

messages.author: 296a3eb14b082592
messages.subject: Problem with writeWave after using ffilter: file contains no sound
parts:
Hi all, 
The problem I am having can be reproduced as follows

library(wave)
data(tico)
f<-ffilter(tico, from = 2.78-0.5, to = 2.78+0.5, output="Wave") # the from and to numbers aren't really important here
writeWave(f,"sample.wav")
Warning message:
In writeWave(f, "sample.wav") :
  channels' data will be rounded to integers for writing the wave file

When I try to play the file I get, it plays, but there is no sound.  What is going on here, and how can I fix it?

Cheers!

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Problem with writeWave after using ffilter: file contains no sound
parts:
Hi,

savewav(f, file="sample.wav")
should work.

You should also use fir() instead of ffilter(), it works better and is faster.

HTH,

Jerome
